messages.subject: Using Cauchy(0, 2.5) prior
parts:
Hi All...

I am trying to set up a model where I can use a weakly informative Cauchy prior with center 0 and scale 2.5 (Gelman, 2010: http://www.stat.columbia.edu/~gelman/research/unpublished/priors7.pdf). You can do this with Gelman's "arm package, but I am trying to set it up using INLA (which is much more efficient for my purposes). Could someone please help me out with this. The "arm" code is given below.

library(Zelig); data(turnout) #Using the "turnout" data from the "Zelig" package

library(arm)
bayesglm.1 = bayesglm(vote ~ race + age,
                      family=binomial(link=logit),
                      prior.df=1, prior.scale=2.5,
                      data=turnout)
display(bayesglm.1)
